name: Performance Monitor
description: Weekly performance analysis comparing bundle size, test duration, and build times against baseline
instructions:
Run a weekly performance health check:

1. Bundle size: Build the project and compare bundle sizes against last week's baseline. Flag any bundle that grew > 10%.
2. Build time: Measure and compare build duration. Flag if > 20% slower than baseline.
3. Test suite duration: Run tests and compare timing. Flag slow tests (> 5s each).
4. Dependency bloat: Check for large dependencies that could be replaced with lighter alternatives.
5. Code complexity: Identify functions with cyclomatic complexity > 10 that were added or changed this week.

Provide a summary report with:
- Trend chart (text-based) for bundle size over last 4 weeks
- Top 5 largest modules by size
- Top 5 slowest tests
- Recommendations for quick wins

Update the performance baseline file at `docs/performance-baseline.json` with this week's measurements.
